RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor between you in the selection process. An all-female panel selecting one female candidate over another does not indicate sex discrimination. The successful applicant possessed relevant qualifications—specifically international project leadership—that may have simply aligned better with the ministry's current needs.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias would appear baseless and could damage your professional standing within the civil service. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, focusing constructively on which competencies you can strengthen for future senior advancement.
